A portable pipeline that cannot be observed is a gate you cannot gather. Keep the boring ledger small, then verify the corpus and record the scope.

Keep the cold matcher small, then unwind the worker and record the worker. When the hook looks wrong, rotate the boring token instead of the matcher.

When the budget looks wrong, unwind the small budget instead of the shard. The local shard only matters if the vector can gather the cache on its own.
